Software Engineering Intern   

This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office. 
 
 Who We Are: 

 Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

 Job Description: 
    
 As a Software Engineering Intern, you will help build a world-class web application that offers innovative ways to configure and visualize a highly scalable cloud and network management platform. Working alongside experienced engineers, you will contribute to frameworks that are widely deployed, explore emerging technologies, and get hands-on experience contributing to an open source project. This is a chance to grow your skills on real production work, with mentorship and support throughout.

 What You’ll Do: 

• Join a product-oriented Agile team and learn from system architects and senior engineers 
• Collaborate with designers, front-end engineers, and back-end engineers to help build reliable APIs 
• Help bring UI mockups to life using JavaScript and React 
• Contribute to backend web applications and scalable software under the guidance of a mentor 
• Take part in regular team meetings to help identify and fix technical and usability issues 
• Write and run tests to help keep code quality high 
• Stay curious about new technologies, trends, and standards, and share what you learn with the team 
 Responsibilities: 

• Coursework, personal projects, or prior internship experience in web application development 
• Familiarity with JavaScript and at least one of Go, Python, or TypeScript 
• Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and a modern JavaScript framework such as React or Angular 
• Understanding of RESTful APIs and how front-end and back-end systems communicate 
• Familiarity with version control (e.g., Git) 
• Eagerness to learn, take feedback, and work in a collaborative team 
 Education & Experience: 
 
• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field. 
• Familiarity with programming languages or technical tools relevant to the role. 
 Knowledge & Skills: 

• Exposure to TypeScript, React, or RxJS 
• Understanding of object-oriented design principles 
• Experience writing unit tests or familiarity with testing frameworks 
• Coursework or projects in AI, machine learning, neural networks, or NLP 
• Exposure to server-side technologies such as Node.js, Java, Golang, MySQL, or MongoDB 
• Familiarity with CI/CD concepts or tools 
• Experience with front-end tooling such as npm, yarn, or Webpack 
• Interest in data visualization libraries such as D3.js or Canvas/WebGL 
• Contributions to open source projects or a portfolio of personal projects (e.g., on GitHub) 
• Strong written and verbal communication skills 

 Impact/Scope: 
 
• University students actively enrolled in a university/college/institution pursuing a Bachelor's degree in a technical area of study, and who typically works during school breaks and then returns to their university. While this applies to most interns, there may be opportunities for full-time students to work as part-time interns during the school year in some countries. 
 
 Accessibility 

 HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here .

 Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability. 

 What We Can Offer You: 

 Health & Wellbeing 
 We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.
 
 Personal & Professional Development 
 We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.
 
 Unconditional Inclusion 
 We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

 Let's Stay Connected: 

 Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

role: Internship, AI – Agentic & Machine Learning Development
jd:
Are you an aspiring professional looking to gain hands-on experience and expand your skill set in a real-world business environment? The AI – Agentic & Machine Learning Development Internship offers an exciting opportunity to apply your knowledge, build practical skills, and contribute to meaningful work. 

At VSP Vision, we’re on a mission to help people see every possibility—and we do that through our strategic business pillars that connect nearly 90 million patients and their health data to network doctors across the globe. 

As the AI – Agentic & Machine Learning Development Intern, you’ll partner with experienced professionals and support a dynamic team across key functions. This role provides exposure to the day-to-day operations of a multi-faceted organization while helping you develop critical business competencies. 
 
 Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to design and deliver AI and machine learning solutions that address business needs 

 Develop, test, and optimize AI agents, prompts, workflows, and machine learning models using structured and unstructured data 

 Create contextual data layers and orchestration frameworks that improve agent and model performance 

 Evaluate solutions for accuracy, scalability, and effectiveness, including testing edge cases and failure modes 

 Document experiments, model performance, agent iterations, and key insights to support continuous improvement and knowledge sharing 

 Job Specifications 

 Ability to work remotely within the United States, including private or semi-private workspace 

 Availability to participate for the full 10-week program – Monday through Friday 

 Access to high-speed internet – Required technology will be provided

 For roles that are remote (i.e., Work From Home (WFH)) or hybrid (i.e., partial onsite at a VSP location and WFH), must demonstrate a high level of engagement in virtual environments, including maintaining camera presence during meetings to support effective communication and team alignment

 Preferred Skills   

 Building and refining AI agents using LLMs and multimodal models for tasks such as data exploration, scenario planning, and workflow automation 

 Designing prompts and workflows that enable agents to reason, plan, and act autonomously 

 Working with structured and unstructured datasets, metadata and metrics definitions to create a contextual layer that enables agent performance 

 Build, train, and evaluate ML models for tasks such as classification, regression, clustering, and anomaly detection 

 Optimize models for accuracy, efficiency, and scalability using techniques like hyperparameter tuning and cross-validation 

 Education Level: Currently enrolled and in good standing at an accredited college or university, with at least junior-level (3rd year) standing  

 Degree Target : ​Data Science, AI, Computer Science or related field​ 

 Program Dates: June 1, 2027 to August 6, 2027 

 #LI-VISIONCARE

 Compensation range for the role is listed below. Applicable salary ranges may differ across markets. Actual pay will be determined based on experience and other job-related factors permitted by law.
  
 Salary Ranges: $30.50 - $36.50

 VSP Vision is an equal opportunity employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to age, gender, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status .  We maintain a drug-free workplace and perform pre-employment substance abuse testing.   

 Unincorporated LA County Residents: Qualified Applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act, and any other similar laws.
